parsed.name: 串口连接适配器
parsed.description: 用于实验设备通信的非物理软件组件，通过串口建立与仪器的命令/响应通信。它负责打开和关闭串口、后台监听数据、发送消息并接收设备回复，供上层实验控制模块与串口仪器交互。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component used for laboratory device communication over a serial port. It opens and closes the serial connection, listens for incoming data in the background, transmits messages, and receives device replies for higher-level experiment control modules.

actions.description: 打开并初始化串口连接。
actions.description_en: Open and initialize the serial connection.

actions.description: 后台监听串口数据并将收到的回复放入缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Listen for serial data in the background and place received replies into the buffer.

actions.description: 关闭串口连接并停止监听线程。
actions.description_en: Close the serial connection and stop the listener thread.

actions.description: 检查串口连接是否处于打开状态。
actions.description_en: Check whether the serial connection is open.

actions.description: 通过串口发送消息到设备。
actions.description_en: Transmit a message to the device over the serial connection.

actions.description: 从接收缓冲区读取设备回复。
actions.description_en: Receive a device reply from the receive buffer.
